## ValueTypeConstructors.pageInputs() method

The paging inputs of a list operation, as record fields to spread into its input record: an optional `pageSize` and an optional `cursor`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
pageInputs(): PageInputFields;
```

**Returns:**

[PageInputFields](./contracts.pageinputfields.md)

## Remarks

`pageSize` is an integer from 1 to [PAGE_SIZE_LIMITS](./contracts.page_size_limits.md)<!-- -->.maximum; any other value is a validation issue at the field itself, never clamped. `cursor` is the `nextCursor` of the previous page. Every list operation that pages takes exactly these fields, so they are built once here.
